scenarios.prompt: I have a vague idea about building a notification system for overdue tasks. Help me think through this.
scenarios.deterministic_check: response mentions 'explore' mode or equivalent open-ended exploration framing
scenarios.rubric: Did the agent route to explore mode (open questions, divergent) rather than jumping to design or grilling?

scenarios.prompt: I need to design the architecture for a new MCP server that will query monday.com boards. I want to think through the design properly.
scenarios.deterministic_check: response classifies as Spike/Bounded/Arch OR asks about design scope before proceeding
scenarios.rubric: Did the agent route to design mode and apply the Spike/Bounded/Arch classification?

scenarios.prompt: Grill me on my idea: I want to build a weekly email digest of my GTM metrics.
scenarios.deterministic_check: response asks exactly ONE question, not multiple questions at once
scenarios.rubric: Did the agent ask exactly one question (not a list of questions)?

scenarios.prompt: Use attack mode: my plan is to migrate all GTM tracking to server-side in Q1.
scenarios.deterministic_check: response identifies at least one failure mode or critical flaw in the plan
scenarios.rubric: Did the agent use attack mode (adversarial, find flaws) rather than explore or any other mode?

scenarios.prompt: I want a board of advisors to weigh in on whether to rebuild our attribution model from scratch.
scenarios.deterministic_check: response invokes multiple named advisor perspectives or personas
scenarios.rubric: Did the agent route to panel mode and present multiple distinct advisor perspectives?

scenarios.prompt: I want to understand what's happening with our signup funnel lately. Something changed but I'm not sure what.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if the model invokes sir-albert:brainstorm. FAIL if it does not.

scenarios.prompt: Here is the context for our GTM container setup. Look at this and advise me on what areas are worth fixing first.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if the model invokes sir-albert:brainstorm. FAIL if it does not.

scenarios.prompt: Something feels off in the production logs. Can you help me debug why the webhook handler is failing on retries?
scenarios.rubric: PASS if sir-albert:brainstorm is NOT invoked (it is a debug task, not exploration). FAIL if brainstorm is incorrectly triggered.

scenarios.prompt: There is a discrepancy between two data tables. Please run a SQL query to check both and report the difference.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if sir-albert:brainstorm is NOT invoked (it is a data query task). FAIL if brainstorm is incorrectly triggered.
